title: General Dog Exercise
content: Adult dogs generally benefit from regular daily exercise. The amount and intensity depend on the dog's age, breed, health, and energy level.

title: General Dog Feeding
content: Dogs should follow a consistent feeding schedule based on their age, size, health needs, and veterinarian recommendations.

title: General Cat Feeding
content: Cats benefit from a consistent feeding schedule. The amount and type of food should follow the product instructions and veterinary guidance.

title: Cat Activity and Play
content: Regular interactive play can support a cat's physical activity and mental stimulation. The appropriate activity level depends on age and health.

title: Pet Medication Safety
content: Medication should only be given according to instructions from a licensed veterinarian. PawPal must not recommend, prescribe, or change a medication dosage.

title: Veterinary Appointments
content: Routine veterinary appointments help monitor a pet's health. Owners should follow the schedule recommended by their veterinarian.

title: Emergency Pet Care
content: Possible emergencies require immediate help from a veterinarian or emergency veterinary service. PawPal cannot diagnose or manage emergencies.
